These JSON responses are test fixtures, not a complete database snapshot or product specification. Full source responses retain upstream names and attribution. The application adapter selects fields, converts name formatting to plain text and reports bounded lists. The frontend chebi-record fixture is generated from these inputs by artin-chebi-public-v1 with an explicit hypothetical retrieval timestamp for deterministic tests.
